title: Sevagan – Emergency Blood Donor Matching Platform
description: An award-winning emergency blood donation platform that connects donors and recipients in real-time. Features OTP-based secure authentication, automated SMS alerts to nearby donors, and a mobile-responsive interface for time-critical medical emergencies.
features: Real-time Geo-Matching: Automatically identifies nearby registered blood donors during urgent medical requests.
Instant SMS Broadcasting: Integrates Twilio SMS API to trigger immediate broadcast alerts to matching blood group donors.
OTP-Based Verification: Secure multi-step verification to ensure authentic donor availability and mitigate spam.
Urgency Level Indicators: Criticality categorization (Emergency vs Scheduled) to prioritize life-saving requests.
architecture: Client-Server web architecture built with a lightweight frontend, REST APIs for authentication & donor lookup, and Twilio SMS gateway for emergency notification routing.

title: Sports Turf Booking Site
description: Developed a responsive web application for viewing and booking sports turf slots in real time. Built an instant confirmation system eliminating manual calls and reducing turnaround time with a minimal-click UI.
features: Interactive Slot Selector: Visual grid display showing available, booked, and reserved turf time slots.
Instant Automated Confirmation: Direct reservation generation eliminating phone booking overhead.
Dynamic Pricing Calculator: Real-time calculation based on peak hours, weekend rates, and turf selection.
Mobile-Optimized Interface: Seamless booking experience across mobile devices and tablets.
architecture: Responsive Single Page Application with dynamic DOM manipulation, real-time slot state management, and optimized asset delivery for low-latency booking.
